instructions.title: How to use cURL to Code Converter

steps.title: Paste your cURL command
steps.description: Copy a cURL command from your terminal, browser DevTools, API documentation, or Postman and paste it into the input area. Supports all cURL flags including headers, authentication, and request body.

steps.title: Select target language and library
steps.description: Choose your target programming language (Python, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Java, Ruby, C#, etc.) and HTTP library (fetch, axios, requests, Guzzle, net/http). The converter generates idiomatic code for each.

steps.title: Review generated code
steps.description: The converter instantly generates production-ready code with proper error handling, async/await patterns, type safety, and best practices for your chosen language.

steps.title: Copy and use in your project

troubleshooting: Parsing fails: Ensure your cURL command starts with 'curl' and has valid syntax
Missing headers in output: Check that -H flags are properly quoted in your cURL
Authentication not converted: Verify -u or --header Authorization flags are present
Body not included: Ensure -d or --data flags are properly formatted
Browser compatibility: Use latest version of Chrome, Firefox, or Edge for best results
